card.name: Per-kg part of dose units
card.fires_on: The "/kg" part of a weight-based dose unit such as mg/kg or mcg/kg, right after a dose number. Also fires on "mg" after a number and on "FD" in dye names.

modes.label: Per-kilogram dosing
modes.description: The "/kg" piece right after a unit like mg, mcg or mEq in a dose.
modes.example: The recommended starting dose of sapropterin dihydrochloride powder for oral solution is 10 mg<</kg>> taken once daily.

modes.label: Unit after a number
modes.description: The unit "mg" directly after a dose number.
modes.example: the recommended dose is 50<< mg>> taken, as needed, approximately 1

modes.label: Dye name start
modes.description: "FD" at the start of FD&C colorant names in ingredient lists.
modes.example: D&C Red No. 7,<< FD>>&C Blue No. 2, FD
